title: Keyless victory
features:
1. Automation Tab
 1. Set Current Position as Block Location (Button): Allows you to stand where the blocks are located and press this button. The script saves your exact location as the dedicated starting point for gathering blocks, removing the need for unreliable automatic detection.
 2. Set Current Position as Win Trip (Trophy) (Button): Allows you to stand at the location where you want to drop off or deposit your items (e.g., the trophy or win zone). The script locks in these coordinates as your destination.
 Enable Optimized Loop (Toggle): Activates the efficient automated loop. Once turned on, your character smoothly tweens back and forth in a direct cycle: Block Location \rightarrow Win Trip Location \rightarrow Block Location (without wandering into the void or returning to unnecessary start points).
 Flight Speed (Slider): Controls how fast your character moves between points (adjustable from 50 to 1000 studs per second), regulating the speed of the smooth tweening.
2. Utility & Protection Tab
 Walk Speed (Slider): Adjusts your character's standard walking speed (from 16 to 200 studs/s). This setting persists even if your character resets or respawns.
 Enable Noclip (Toggle): Allows you to walk and fly through walls, floors, and objects without colliding with anything, preventing you from getting stuck during automated travel.
 Enable Anti-Void (Toggle): A safety fallback feature. If a glitch or calculation error sends you below the map (lower than Y = -20), this instantly triggers, zeroes your velocity, and teleports you safely back up to a height of 10 studs.
